title: Due to
subtitle: 「由於」，究竟是哪一種因果關係？
description: 「由於」，究竟是哪一種因果關係？

words.note: 最常見、最直接的替換之一，後面通常接名詞、名詞短語或代名詞。
words.example: The match was cancelled because of heavy rain.

exercises.original: The outdoor concert was cancelled due to heavy rain.
exercises.zh: 戶外音樂會因大雨而取消。

options.explanation: therefore = therefore 引出結果，不能直接接 heavy rain 作原因短語。
despite = 意思相反，表示即使下雨仍發生某事。
because of = heavy rain 是名詞短語，所以 because of 可直接、自然地替換 due to。
although = 後面需要完整子句，不能直接接名詞短語。
so = 應連接結果句，不放在 cancelled ___ heavy rain 的位置。
because = 後面需要子句，如 because it rained heavily。

exercises.original: The delivery arrived late due to traffic congestion.
exercises.zh: 送貨因交通擠塞而遲到。

options.explanation: therefore = 不是用來引出名詞原因。
although = 需完整子句且表示讓步。
despite = 若用 despite，意思會變成『儘管交通擠塞仍……』。
because of = traffic congestion 是名詞短語，因此 because of 是最直接的替換。
because = 需改成 because traffic was congested 等完整子句。

exercises.original: Several classes were moved online due to the heating failure.
exercises.zh: 數節課因暖氣系統故障而改為網上進行。

options.explanation: therefore = 需要另起結果結構。
since = 若用 since，需加完整子句，如 since the heating failed。
so = 引出結果，不接在此位置。
because of = 原因是 the heating failure 這個名詞短語，because of 完整保留原意和結構。

words.note: 較正式，常見於書面語和公告，後面通常接名詞或名詞短語。
words.example: The flight was delayed owing to technical problems.
words.exampleZh: 航班因技術問題而延誤。

exercises.original: The flight was delayed due to technical problems.
exercises.zh: 航班因技術問題而延誤。

options.explanation: thanks to = technical problems 是負面原因，一般不用帶正面意味的 thanks to。
therefore = 不是原因介系詞短語。
although = 後接子句且表示讓步。
owing to = 正式交通公告中 owing to technical problems 很自然，意思與原句一致。

exercises.original: The museum is closed today due to essential maintenance.
exercises.zh: 博物館今天因必要維修而關閉。

options.explanation: owing to = owing to 很適合公告語體，後面可直接接 essential maintenance。

exercises.original: Train services were disrupted due to signalling problems.
exercises.zh: 列車服務因訊號系統問題而受阻。

options.explanation: thanks to = 負面後果不適合一般正面用法。
therefore = 不能直接接原因名詞。
result = 單獨 result 不能作介系詞短語。
owing to = 交通服務公告中 owing to signalling problems 是自然正式搭配。

words.note: 強調某結果是前面原因直接造成的，語氣比 because of 更明確地突出因果結果。
words.example: Several roads were closed as a result of flooding.
words.exampleZh: 多條道路因水浸而封閉。

exercises.original: Several roads were closed due to flooding.
exercises.zh: 多條道路因水浸而封閉。
exercises.upgrade: as a result of · 由於；作為……的結果

options.explanation: despite = 表示讓步，與封路因果相反。
therefore = 引出結果，不是原因短語。
as a result of = 道路封閉是 flooding 直接造成的結果，因此 as a result of 很精確。

exercises.original: Sales fell sharply due to the supply shortage.
exercises.zh: 銷售因供應短缺而大幅下降。
exercises.upgrade: as a result of · 由於；作為……的結果

options.explanation: thanks to = 下跌是負面結果，不宜一般使用 thanks to。
as a result of = 本句明確描述 shortage 導致 sales fell，as a result of 突出結果與原因的直接關係。

exercises.original: The park remained closed for weeks due to storm damage.
exercises.zh: 公園因風暴造成的損毀而關閉數星期。
exercises.upgrade: as a result of · 由於；作為……的結果

options.explanation: as a result of = storm damage 導致長時間閉園，as a result of 能自然突出後果。
so = 不能接 storm damage 作原因短語。
despite = 意思會變成『儘管受損仍關閉』，邏輯不對。

words.note: 較正式或略帶舊式語感，表示某事因某個原因而發生。
words.example: The event was postponed on account of bad weather.
words.exampleZh: 活動因天氣惡劣而延期。

exercises.original: The event was postponed due to bad weather.
exercises.zh: 活動因天氣惡劣而延期。
exercises.upgrade: on account of · 由於；因為

options.explanation: despite = 表示讓步，不是原因。
on account of = on account of bad weather 是正式而自然的原因表達。

exercises.original: He missed the meeting due to illness.
exercises.zh: 他因病缺席會議。
exercises.upgrade: on account of · 由於；因為

options.explanation: on account of = illness 是名詞，正式語境可直接用 on account of illness。
thanks to = illness 為負面原因，一般不合正面語氣。
because = 需 because he was ill。

exercises.original: Access was restricted due to safety concerns.
exercises.zh: 出於安全考慮，進入受到限制。
exercises.upgrade: on account of · 由於；因為

options.explanation: on account of = 限制 access 的原因是 safety concerns，on account of 可完整保留因果。

words.note: 較正式，強調某件事是另一件事所造成的後果，常見於分析和說明文。
words.example: Production fell as a consequence of the power shortage.
words.exampleZh: 生產因電力短缺而下降。

exercises.original: Production fell due to the power shortage.
exercises.zh: 生產因電力短缺而下降。
exercises.upgrade: as a consequence of · 由於；作為……的後果

options.explanation: as a consequence of = production fell 是 shortage 的後果，正式分析語體中 as a consequence of 很自然。
thanks to = 生產下降不是通常的正面結果。

exercises.original: The company lost several clients due to repeated delays.
exercises.zh: 公司因多次延誤而失去數名客戶。
exercises.upgrade: as a consequence of · 由於；作為……的後果

options.explanation: as a consequence of = 失去客戶是 repeated delays 累積造成的後果，因此 as a consequence of 最貼切。
so = 不能直接接 repeated delays。
therefore = 不能作介系詞短語。

exercises.original: Water levels dropped due to several months of low rainfall.
exercises.zh: 水位因數月低降雨而下降。
exercises.upgrade: as a consequence of · 由於；作為……的後果

options.explanation: thanks to = 通常帶正面意味，不適合這個負面／中性結果。
as a consequence of = 長期 low rainfall 導致 water levels dropped，正式說明文中 as a consequence of 很合適。
therefore = 不接原因名詞短語。

words.note: 通常表示正面或有利的原因，但也可帶諷刺意味；不能一般地取代所有 due to。
words.example: The project finished early thanks to careful planning.
words.exampleZh: 多虧周密規劃，項目提早完成。

exercises.original: The project finished ahead of schedule due to careful planning.
exercises.zh: 項目因周密規劃而提前完成。

options.explanation: despite = 若用 despite，會表示規劃本應阻礙項目，邏輯不對。
thanks to = ahead of schedule 是正面結果，而 careful planning 是有利原因，所以 thanks to 最自然。
therefore = 不能直接接 careful planning。

exercises.original: The team met the deadline due to everyone's extra effort.
exercises.zh: 團隊多虧所有人的額外努力而如期完成工作。

options.explanation: owing to = 語法可行，但較中性；本題要表達帶感謝意味的正面原因。
thanks to = everyone's extra effort 帶來成功結果，thanks to 能表達正面因果和感謝色彩。

exercises.original: She recovered quickly due to excellent medical care.
exercises.zh: 她多虧優質醫療照護而迅速康復。

options.explanation: despite = 會變成醫療照護與康復形成讓步，不合理。
thanks to = excellent medical care 是促成快速康復的正面原因，因此 thanks to 很貼切。

words.note: 當原句可改寫成原因子句時，可用連接詞 because；其後需要完整子句，而不是名詞短語。
words.example: The match was cancelled because it was raining heavily.
words.exampleZh: 比賽取消了，因為當時下著大雨。

exercises.original: The match was cancelled due to heavy rain.
exercises.zh: 比賽取消了，因為當時下著大雨。

options.explanation: because of = 若保留 it was raining heavily，because of 後不能直接接完整子句。
owing to = 同樣需名詞短語，如 owing to heavy rain。
because = 改寫後原因變成完整子句 it was raining heavily，所以應用連接詞 because。
so = 需要把句子重組成 It was raining, so...。

exercises.original: The meeting ended early due to a lack of time.
exercises.zh: 會議提早結束，因為沒有足夠時間。

options.explanation: because of = 不能直接接 there was not enough time。
as a result of = 後面要名詞短語。
because = 當原因寫成完整子句 there was not enough time 時，because 是最直接選擇。
therefore = 不是原因從屬連接詞。
on account of = 後面同樣要名詞短語。

exercises.original: The road was closed due to a fallen tree.
exercises.zh: 道路關閉了，因為有一棵樹倒在路上。

options.explanation: owing to = 若用 owing to，需改回名詞結構如 owing to a fallen tree。
thanks to = 負面情況通常不合。
because = 原因被完整表達成 a tree had fallen across it，因此用 because。
as a consequence of = 需後接名詞短語。

words.note: 作原因連接詞時可表示『因為』，通常引出一個大家已知或較不突出的原因；其後接完整子句。
words.example: Since the road was closed, we took another route.
words.exampleZh: 由於道路封閉，我們改走另一條路。

exercises.original: We took another route due to the road closure.
exercises.zh: 由於道路封閉，我們改走另一條路。

options.explanation: because of = 後面不能直接接 the road was closed 這個子句。
owing to = 同樣需要名詞短語。
since = 原因改成完整子句，而且是較自然的背景原因，因此句首 Since ... 很合適。
therefore = 不能引導原因從句。
as a result of = 後面需要名詞短語。

exercises.original: The office closed early due to the approaching storm.
exercises.zh: 由於暴風雨逐漸逼近，辦公室提早關門。

options.explanation: because of = 需名詞短語，不接 the storm was approaching。
on account of = 同樣後接名詞。
since = the storm was approaching 是完整原因子句，作背景理由時 since 很自然。
so = 若用 so 要改成兩個主要子句。

exercises.original: We decided to leave early due to the worsening traffic.
exercises.zh: 由於交通愈來愈擠塞，我們決定提早離開。

options.explanation: owing to = 不能直接接完整子句。
because of = 同樣需名詞短語。
since = 交通惡化是已知背景原因，句首 Since 能自然帶出決定。

words.note: 可作原因連接詞，語氣通常比 because 輕，常用於原因已知或不是句子重點的情況。
words.example: As the weather was getting worse, the organizers ended the event early.
words.exampleZh: 由於天氣愈來愈差，主辦方提早結束活動。

exercises.original: The organizers ended the event early due to worsening weather.
exercises.zh: 由於天氣愈來愈差，主辦方提早結束活動。

options.explanation: because of = 後面不能直接接 the weather was getting worse。
as = 原因作背景資訊而非句子焦點時，As 加完整子句很自然。
on account of = 需名詞短語。

exercises.original: The shop closed early due to very few customers remaining.
exercises.zh: 由於當時只剩很少顧客，商店提早關門。

options.explanation: because of = 不能接完整子句 very few customers remained。
so = 可重組，但不是此句位置。
as = 完整原因子句作背景，較輕的因果連接詞 as 很合適。

exercises.original: The path became dangerous due to the temperature falling below freezing.
exercises.zh: 由於氣溫降至冰點以下，小徑變得危險。

options.explanation: as = the temperature fell below freezing 是完整背景原因，as 可自然引出。
because of = 需名詞化結構。
on account of = 需名詞短語。

words.note: 在某些固定或較正式語境中可表示原因，尤其常見於 through negligence / error / misunderstanding 等搭配。
words.example: The files were deleted through human error.
words.exampleZh: 檔案因人為錯誤而被刪除。

exercises.original: The files were deleted due to human error.
exercises.zh: 檔案因人為錯誤而被刪除。

options.explanation: thanks to = 刪檔是負面結果，通常不用 thanks to。
through = through human error 是自然固定搭配，表示某結果因錯誤而發生。

exercises.original: The payment was sent twice due to an administrative mistake.
exercises.zh: 付款因行政失誤而被重複發送。

options.explanation: through = 在 mistake/error 這類原因後，through 可自然表示『因……而』。
as a result = 缺少 of，不能直接接名詞短語。

exercises.original: The confidential message became public due to a misunderstanding.
exercises.zh: 機密訊息因誤會而公開。

options.explanation: thanks to = 負面後果通常不合正面語氣。
through = through a misunderstanding 是表示事情因誤會而發生的自然用法。

words.note: 非常正式，常見於法律、行政或正式文件，用來表示原因或依據。
words.example: The application was rejected by reason of incomplete documentation.
words.exampleZh: 申請因文件不完整而被拒絕。

exercises.original: The application was rejected due to incomplete documentation.
exercises.zh: 申請因文件不完整而被拒絕。
exercises.upgrade: by reason of · 由於；基於……原因

options.explanation: by reason of = 在正式行政／法律語體中，by reason of incomplete documentation 可表示拒絕原因。
thanks to = 拒絕申請不是正面結果。

exercises.original: The contract may be terminated due to a serious breach.
exercises.zh: 合約可因嚴重違約而終止。
exercises.upgrade: by reason of · 由於；基於……原因

options.explanation: by reason of = contract、breach 和 termination 屬正式法律語境，by reason of 很貼切。
thanks to = 不合負面法律後果。

exercises.original: Access may be denied due to failure to provide identification.
exercises.zh: 如未能提供身份證明，可能會被拒絕進入。
exercises.upgrade: by reason of · 由於；基於……原因

options.explanation: because = 需完整子句，如 because identification was not provided。
by reason of = 正式規則中列明拒絕 access 的理由，by reason of 是合適的正式表達。

words.note: 常放在名詞後，表示該情況或問題是某原因所造成；語法位置和 due to 不完全相同。
words.example: The delays resulting from the storm affected several services.
words.exampleZh: 暴風雨造成的延誤影響了多項服務。

exercises.original: The delays due to the storm affected several services.
exercises.zh: 暴風雨造成的延誤影響了多項服務。

options.explanation: because = 不能直接放在名詞 delays 後形成修飾語。
resulting from = 這裡 due to the storm 修飾名詞 delays，改成後置分詞短語 resulting from the storm 很自然。
therefore = 不是後置修飾結構。

exercises.original: Damage due to flooding forced the store to close.
exercises.zh: 水浸造成的損壞迫使商店關閉。

options.explanation: because of = 可表原因，但若直接修飾 Damage，不如 resulting from 清楚。
resulting from = resulting from flooding 清楚指出 damage 的來源，同時自然修飾前面的名詞。
thanks to = 負面損壞不合通常語氣。

exercises.original: Health problems due to prolonged stress can affect sleep.
exercises.zh: 長期壓力造成的健康問題會影響睡眠。

options.explanation: because = 不能直接作名詞後置修飾。
resulting from = 此處要修飾 health problems 並說明其成因，resulting from 是自然且精確的結構。

falseSynonyms.zh: 因此不等於由於 therefore 表示結果，通常連接兩個獨立概念；due to 引出原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The road was flooded; therefore, the school closed. The school closed due to flooding.

falseSynonyms.zh: 所以不等於由於 so 引出結果；due to 引出原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It was raining, so the match was cancelled. The match was cancelled due to rain.

falseSynonyms.zh: 儘管不等於由於 despite 表示讓步或對比，意思不是因果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Despite the rain, the event continued. Due to the rain, the event was cancelled.

falseSynonyms.zh: 雖然不等於由於 although 引出讓步子句；due to 引出原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Although it was late, they continued. They stopped due to the late hour.

falseSynonyms.zh: 子句與名詞短語不同 because 後接完整子句；because of 後接名詞、名詞短語或代名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We stayed inside because it was raining. We stayed inside because of the rain.

falseSynonyms.zh: 固定結構不同 due to 表示『由於』；單獨 due 常表示『到期的、預定的、應得的』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The delay was due to fog. The payment is due tomorrow.

falseSynonyms.zh: 結果與原因短語不同 result 是名詞或動詞；as a result of 才是表示原因的介系詞短語。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The closure was a result of flooding. The road closed as a result of flooding.

falseSynonyms.zh: 語氣不同 thanks to 通常帶正面意味；due to 本身中性，可用於好或壞的原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Thanks to her help, we finished early. Due to a fault, the system stopped.
